decisions.text: An order line snapshots its catalog item's identity, name, and image at purchase time
The order line uses the basket's recorded unit price, not the catalog's current price
The calculated order total is stored as a value to make it expressible in this model
The database assigns unique order and order-line identities; collisions are modeled as rejected outcomes

language_gaps.text: A basket may contain multiple lines; this model handles one representative line per invocation
Catalog lines are validated before the buyer identifier, matching the source operation order
The Address type has no field validation; checkout supplies a fixed address
OrderDate is assigned from the current time, which is not modeled
The URI composer may rewrite the image base URL; this model only checks for an empty image
